statements.subject: client
statements.description: A client MUST implement the capability to send an OPTIONS request and a server or a proxy MUST implement the capability to respond to an OPTIONS request.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A client MUST implement the capability to send an OPTIONS request and a server or a proxy MUST implement the capability to respond to an OPTIONS request.

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: In addition to this "MUST-implement" functionality, clients, servers and proxies MAY provide support both for sending OPTIONS requests and for generating responses to the requests.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Regardless of the scope of the request, the Public header MUST always be included in the OPTIONS response, listing the methods that are supported by the responding RTSP agent.
actions: include Public header listing supported methods in OPTIONS response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In addition, if the scope of the request is limited to a media resource, the Allow header MUST be included in the response to enumerate the set of methods that are allowed for that resource unless the set of methods completely matches the set in the Public header.
actions: include Allow header enumerating allowed methods in OPTIONS response when scope is limited to a media resource and the allowed method set differs from the Public header set

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the given resource is not available, the RTSP agent SHOULD return an appropriate response code, such as 3rr or 4xx.
actions: return appropriate error response code (3rr or 4xx) when requested resource is not available

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: The Supported header MAY be included in the request to query the set of features that are supported by the responding RTSP agent.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: An OPTIONS request intended for keeping alive an RTSP session MUST include the Session header with the associated session identifier.
actions: include Session header carrying session identifier in OPTIONS keep-alive request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Such a request SHOULD also use the media or the aggregated control URI as the Request-URI.
actions: use media or aggregated control URI as Request-URI in OPTIONS keep-alive request
